<!--
Write for a reviewer who only has the repository. No links to private or tool-hosted pages, no AI attribution.
Cut any section that does not apply. A small chore can be a few sentences with no headings.
-->

## Why

<!-- The problem or need. For a fix, what was wrong and what the user or caller saw. -->

## What

<!--
What the change does, as short bullets. Name new settings, routes, capabilities, migrations and wire names.
For a fix, "What the fix does".
-->

## Testing

<!-- What ran (`scripts/check.sh`, the suites touched) and what each new test proves. A bugfix says its regression test fails without the fix. -->

## Not verified

<!-- Anything that ran only in CI or not at all, and risks the reviewer should weigh. Cut if there are none. -->
